rows.title: CKO B3 Canonical Object Population and Taxonomy Contract
rows.applicability: B3: every object/tool/library/content/resource identity must originate in Master Data, preserve canonical UUID/business key/version, bind to applicable universal and domain/module REG, avoid class inference without controlled evidence, and remain traceable to validator/renderer/runtime projections.

rows.title: CKO B4 End-to-End Binding Registry Contract
rows.applicability: B4: every known canonical object must expose traceable MD/version, field, REG/evidence, shared and specific validator/engine/renderer bindings, route/projection, runtime, rights and deployment states; shared-stack binding must never be represented as tool-specific computation PASS.

rows.title: CKO B5 Digital Twin State and Reconciliation Contract
rows.applicability: B5: every canonical twin node must resolve to a governed source identity and explicitly carry intended, controlled, deployed and observed states. Controlled state must derive from B3/B4 evidence; deployed/observed state requires empirical evidence and defaults fail-closed. Digital Twin graph lineage must be bidirectional through objects/layers/capabilities without asserting Nurse-PaLM or production runtime operation.
